howtos.title: Teach an agent your style with a sentence scorer
howtos.what: Matt Pocock's method: rate an agent's example sentences one at a time so it learns to write like you.
copy: Have the agent send it example sentences.
Score them one at a time, swipe-style: either 1-4 per sentence or pick between options.
howtos.whenToUse: When an agent's writing doesn't sound like you and you want it to learn your style.
